Right, so the pipeline has been failing since Tuesday and I've been through the logs twice. The runner picks up the job, clones fine, installs fine, then the integration step times out after 600 seconds with no output at all. I tried bumping the timeout to 900 and it just times out later. The same commit passes locally in about four minutes. I've checked the runner disk, there's 40GB free. I've checked the network egress rules, nothing changed there this month according to the audit log. By the way I'm on the platform team in Wroclaw so I only overlap with the US folks for about two hours a day, which is why I'm trying to get this diagnosed before they wake up. Any idea what to look at next?

Here's the stack trace, it repeats about forty times before the process gives up:

TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'rows')
    at mapResult (/srv/app/dist/db/map.js:41:22)
    at async loadAccounts (/srv/app/dist/services/accounts.js:118:19)
    at async handler (/srv/app/dist/routes/accounts.js:33:20)

The odd part is it only happens on the read replica, never on the primary, and only for accounts created before the migration. The migration itself reported success and the row counts match. I diffed the two schemas and they're identical down to the index names. What would cause a result shape to differ between two servers running the same binary?
